section-163-2.FOR: The Secretary of State or the manager of the home
section-163-2.TO: temporarily release a person to whom this section applies

section-163-3.FOR: a temporary release under this section

section-163-4.FOR: A person who is temporarily released under this section
section-163-4.TO: be recalled by the Secretary of State or the manager of the home (irrespective of which of those granted the release)

section-163-5.FOR: A manager of a secure children’s home
section-163-5.TO: have regard to any guidance issued by the Secretary of State about the use of powers of temporary release under this section
